steps.text: 5:20 P.M. \ Clear
Columbia City, Tkaronto
The name's Dylan, Rhodes Island low-altitude aircraft pilot, and I'm currently running pell-mell around the city.
I should be sitting in the cockpit of my aircraft, joystick in hand. The only things I should be facing down are turbulence and terrain.
Instead, I'm clutching one half of an automatic assault crossbow in my hands, and hell, the first time I heard of this model was earlier this morning. Even just half of it is damned heavy.
My palms are all sweaty. If I have to end up in a warzone, I sure as hell shouldn't be on the ground, let alone in some dark alley in Columbia.
I just hope to God that my enemy isn't... Ugh.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dylan, I got my hands full over here. Can you help a gal out and tell me what it says?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: It says Police. The 'police' of Tkaronto.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: He started it.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: But it seems... probably not the real deal. A real botch-job if I've ever seen one.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: At least he looked the part, pretty much the same as the guys up on the roof earlier this morning. Better than the ones that didn't have a uniform ready.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So let me ask this question again: what kind of cops wind their automatic assault crossbows during questioning?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Columbian cops?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Very funny. You know he's not a cop, at least not the kind we're used to dealing with.
I lift my eyes to cast a glance at the black-clad man collapsed in the alley, and then lower my gaze again to the half-a-weapon in my hands.
It was pointed straight at my chest just a moment ago, but now it's smashed into two pieces.
This 'policeman' is unconscious. If Blaze remembered the Doctor's instructions when she struck, then he should still be able to cling to life.
The Rhodes Island team arrived in Tkaronto yesterday.
No matter how many times I experience it, this kind of speed always surprises me as a pilot—
Rhodes Island is in the process of steaming to the Grand Knight Territory, and we've crossed over the entire western wastelands by air. The entire western wastelands, I say.

According to the plan, after Amiya and the Doctor finish their business, we'll take the same route back to Rhodes Island. The Grand Knight Territory might not have finished its urban subdivision assembly at this time.
All I know is Rhodes Island was invited to visit during the Kazimierz Major, but I'm in the dark about when and why. But anyway, the sooner we can head back, the better.
If I wasn't in such a hurry, I wouldn't mind taking a few days off to chill in the metropolis... but after this, I'm not in the mood for that anymore.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are we... safe?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No, not until we leave Tkaronto— Maybe not even until we leave Columbia.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Check for me if he's still breathing. It'd be nice if you made sure he kept on breathing.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I... Um, alright.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: This is my first time seeing such a powerful automatic crossbow. Are these weapons common in Columbia?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Automatic weapons like that are a Columbian specialty.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: I wonder how the Doctor's doing...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: As soon as the raid started, the Doctor and Amiya left in a car. No clue if the autopilot system that Closure was fiddling with will work though...

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: What a disaster... Even those two got caught off guard.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: They're only human after all... Sometimes shit happens.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: They took over the hotel and seized all the drug samples we kept behind...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever, we can worry about that later.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We've gotta think of a way to get out of this city safely first.
We've lost everything, but you are still not standing by my side.
Then what has it all been for?
Just to leave the faintest sliver of hope?
But, hope?
Hope?
Don't you know, that hope is a cruel thing indeed?
When you realize it can't be undone, when you realize you are powerless, when you find yourself nothing but desperate...
Hope is enough to drive a perfectly good person mad.

options: But...

steps.text: You want to say something, but you can't move your body.
You seem to be drifting in the void, everything before your eyes so familiar and yet so distant. These are a part of your memories, floating alongside you like fragments.
Like this, you continue to drift with your ceaseless thoughts, watching the familiar woman before you gradually fade away.
You open your eyes, and before you stretches an endless rocky desert. You see a strange, ugly iron bucket helm.
A peculiar man seems to be looking your way, but you cannot see his expression through that rough bucket helm.
10:43 A.M. \ Clear
Gaspar Wildland

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Can you talk?

options: You? Who are you? Where am I?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The friend awakens, little rabbit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!
You feel someone tightly embrace your waist.
But before experiencing this warm embrace, the cold, hard touch of the rocks behind you and the throbbing pain in your head remind you that all is not well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm so glad! You're awake... I don't know what I would've done if you didn't wake up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How are you feeling? Does it hurt anywhere?

options: I'm fine... Just my head hurts a little.
...Nothing serious.
I'm not that frail.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your head hurts? Did you hit it? Let me have a look.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you sure you're fine, Doctor? Do you need me to help you up?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... you should still be careful. You're not in the best shape.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Worry not, little rabbit. There is nothing wrong with this 'Doctor,' at least not physically.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: On a spiritual level, however, one cannot say. You were mumbling a great deal in your slumber, but before you complain, I did not listen closely.

options: Who are you...?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Ah, pardon me for not introducing myself.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: As you can see, I am a merchant.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You can call me Cannot, or Mr. Goodenough should you prefer that instead.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: To be honest, friend, that display you put on earlier was simply too exhilarating. It is not every day one sees someone performing Originium Arts while flying off a cliff. A most excellent show indeed.

options: Off a cliff? What were we...
There might've been a problem with Closure's autopilot system...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This should be Columbia's... eastern wastelands.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That is correct, little rabbit. This is the Gaspar Wildland, and you two are quite fortunate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Fortunate?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Yes, yes. Quite fortunate indeed. Two kilometers further south is a poisonous swamp, and had your car gotten stuck in that, good luck getting it out.

options: I wonder how the others are doing.
Where are the others?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The other operators split off on their own. I'm sure Blaze is taking good care of them...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we can't get a hold of them, or any other branch offices.

options: Wait, what about the communicator?
Wait, what about the provisions?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We left it all on the 'Bad Guy.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not just the communicator. We didn't even have time to pack food or water.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Sounds like a desperate situation indeed, friends?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But there is always a way, if you don't mind...

options: Might as well.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I am quite familiar with this area. I can show you to the nearest Messenger Outpost where, should all go well, you will be able to contact your friends.

options: Who attacked us?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: An excellent question indeed, but the only ones who could answer it are no longer able to speak.
The bucket-headed man points to the nearby cliff, where a unique-looking armed vehicle is emitting a thick, black smoke. By the looks of things, it's been wrecked for quite some time now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mercenaries. They've been chasing us even after we left the city.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Dedicated to their job. Dedicated to the point of giving up their own lives.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: To be frank, Columbian mercenaries range from peerless to useless, and the ones with the resources to hire such dedicated mercenaries can be counted on one hand.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: They seem to have taken quite an interest in you, friends. How exactly did you offend these great moguls?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So it was them...

steps.name: Officer-in-Charge
steps.text: So, Miss Amiya, are you really unwilling to consider the offer?

steps.name: Officer-in-Charge
steps.text: In Columbia, you'll be hard-pressed to find a more suitable partner than Mama John's. We can provide fairly favorable terms for Rhodes Island's drug sales.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you for your generosity, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're only here for technical exchange. Rhodes Island has no plans for any deeper-level commercial cooperation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And the Oripathy analgesics we brought are still undergoing trials. These are more of a proof of concept than a finished product.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The process of researching and developing Oripathy treatments is long and complicated, and in these areas, we still have many opportunities for cooperation in the future.

steps.name: Officer-in-Charge
steps.text: Many opportunities for cooperation in the future...? Hahaha...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They planned this from the very beginning...

options: Should we contact the police first?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Police? Friend, you don't seem to understand where you are.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Mama John's is the largest firm in Tkaronto. The chief of police boasts of his connections to their corporate leadership in order to display his status. I suggest you change your mind.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The fact that they dared to steal your goods in the urban core means that from the very beginning, they never thought anything of you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's all my fault... I bought into their talk.

options: Don't blame yourself. Nobody could've expected them to be like this.
No, I'm just as responsible, Amiya. I should've known.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr... Good...y?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Ah. What is it, Miss Rabbit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You just said you could take us through the wastelands, right?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That I did say, Miss Rabbit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How do you plan to do that? Were you a Catastrophe Messenger?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That is nothing you need to concern yourself over.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I have plied my trade in the wastelands for many years, and that has given me a knack for avoiding Catastrophes.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, I do ask for a small guide fee, two refined Originium Ingots in this case. Not too much to ask for in such a situation, yes?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We only have Columbian Gold Certificates, and won't be able to pay you until we get in touch with our ship. Is that alright?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: No problem! My friend.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... What do you think? We could also figure a way back into the city, to meet up with Blaze and the others.

options: It's too dangerous. Looks like we don't have a choice.
This gentleman seems to have made the choice for us, right?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That is scarcely the case. We always have many choices at any point in our lives, but of course, we tend to pick the best one from the available options.

options: I hope we can have... a fruitful relationship in the coming days?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, my friend!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I trust that this will be a most enjoyable journey.
Five hours later...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: ...As I said, bandits are not the biggest threat in the wastelands. I once knew the most courageous local– he even...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, give me your hand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Phew, we're up.

options: How many hills have we crossed?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is only the second one, Doctor.

options: Let me rest... Let me rest...
(Stay silent, gasping for breath)
I really... let myself go...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha, Doctor, sit down here for a minute.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Friend, at your speed, we will be on the road for at least another whole day.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor might not be able to maintain such a brisk pace.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: We can slow down a touch, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why can't we go a bit slower?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Even as a merchant of the wastelands, there is a limit to the amount of food and water I can carry on me.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: If we slow down too much, we will inevitably run into a supply shortage.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that's the case... Mr. Cannot?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is there a forest nearby? I've heard of an oasis in the wastes of eastern Columbia.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: There is, but what use is it?
Night, above the wastelands, in a dark mountain pass.
A tongue of flame consumes dry branches, and the sound of a wooden spoon tapping against a bowl echoes across the canyon along with Amiya's humming.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These vegetables, as well as the mushrooms here, are pretty much all edible as long as they're cooked through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This kind... is slightly toxic, but can still be eaten in an emergency.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I should've given you more credit, Miss Rabbit.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: To be honest, most friends from the nomadic cities... have no sense of how to survive in the wilds. Many I know will never once step foot in the wastelands.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I see that you have a decent survivalist's skillset. Where are you from? Rim Billiton?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I would not be surprised if you were in fact from Rim Billiton...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Actually, the Doctor taught me all of this, a few years ago...

options: Huh? I did?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes. Back then...

steps.name: Young Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Are these edible?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: These vegetables, as well as the mushrooms here, are pretty much all edible as long as they're cooked through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those were trying times, harrowing times. But they were also good times.
It seems that something is stirring in the back of your mind, but it gradually blurs out.
You try to recall that scene again, but the vague memory is like bubbles that occasionally rise to the water's surface, only to disappear just as quickly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor?

options: I... Is this something that happened before then?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, it's nothing. It did happen a few years ago, but it doesn't matter if you can't remember.
She lowers her head and continues to stir the bowl, but the smile on her face seems somewhat lonelier.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Ahem, I must also say, you've chosen a most prudent location to make camp. Even though we've made a fire, our position is not easy to detect.

options: Are there any bandits around here?
Who's looking for us?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Bandits, bounty hunters, and countless Rusthammers. There are no shortage of annoyances in this land.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rusthammer... I've heard the name before. They're a group of vicious marauders, right?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That description would not be a very rigorous one.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Rusthammer is a loose organization, and it is made up of various smaller groups.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: For example, there is 'Fiends Gang' made up of Sarkaz, and also a group of strange folks who worship Catastrophes as gods. I think they're called 'Followers of the Archosauria', or something.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They worship Catastrophes?

options: Followers of the Archosauria? What a crazy bunch.
Sarkaz? Fiends Gang?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I heard something about a Rusthammer gang in Sargon that called themselves 'Archosauria Devils.' They seemed to have been searching for an 'Archosauria war-god with massive horns on its head.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: An operator from Columbia once told me that Rusthammer used to be just a few, small, scattered groups. Over the past few years though, their numbers have greatly increased, stretching from the mountains of Ursus to the wastelands of Columbia.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Our world is not a peaceful one, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: And the wastelands is no exception. You will encounter all sorts of strange people and strange occurrences.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But you will adapt.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Here, Doctor! Dinner's ready!

options: Thank you, Amiya.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Very good. What a heartfelt scene of intimacy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Cannot!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Ahem... I am simply jesting. My apologies, please do not take it seriously.
At this rate, you will lose everything.
You will be alone, with nothing. Is it worth it?
Loneliness is a poison that erodes the mind. How much do you think you can withstand?
By the time you awaken, there will be no kin at your side. Nobody will recognize your sacrifice, let alone remember it. Is this the future you look forward to?
You wake up.
A crimson glow spills forth from the distant horizon, and the darkness left unto humanity by the Shadow-Moon gradually ebbs.
Frigid wind gnaws at your cheeks as it blows across your face, and the land of Terra once again ushers in a new dawn.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You are up very early, friend.

options: The morning air is refreshing.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Where's the little rabbit? Is she not awake yet?

options: Let her rest a bit longer. What are you doing?
Maybe the aroma of breakfast will be more effective.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Short-tailed fowlbeasts don't have much meat, but they can suffice as breakfast.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: This is a specialty of the Columbian wastelands. Worry not, it's free of charge.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: A new day comes to Terra, and the situation has not changed, as far as I can tell. Nevertheless, good morning, friend!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You were talking in your sleep last night. Your mental state has seemed a bit unstable, do be careful.

options: What did you hear?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I am a trustworthy person. I didn't go out of my way to listen, let alone remember anything. Plus, you were only mumbling. Couldn't really hear anything clearly.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But... Every night, the little rabbit is very concerned about your sleep-talking.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Pardon me for being nosy, but after all the chatting we've done on our journey, it is hard not to take certain impressions. Have you lost your memories, or something of that sort?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I see. If that's some sort of secret, let's say I never asked. It is an uncouth question indeed, and I asked out of simple curiosity.

options: Some things... happened to me, and I lost some of my memories.
...Maybe most of them.
Occasionally, I will recall some of them... just tiny fragments.
Well, maybe not occasionally. Only a few rare times.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Friend, I have a vague idea of what's going on.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Suppose your memory is a spread-out newspaper, and now, someone has spilled a bucket of paint on it.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You can only see bits and pieces of the content through the gaps in the paint, but you can't grasp the full picture of that content.

options: That seems like a pretty good description of my experiences. I am... a stranger to myself.
I can't even say if your analogy is accurate. I... don't know.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It sounds like something that defies all words, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But I am no psychiatrist, and there is not much I can do for you.

options: Sometimes, I even find myself thinking about the kind of person I was before all this.
I don't know who I am. I can only piece myself together from the words of others.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That's not important, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Our existence is often based on how others perceive us. The sum of your 'self' is but the feedback of auditory, visual, and emotional interaction with others.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It doesn't matter what kind of person 'you' are, but from a social point of view, it should be quite clear what kind of person others need you to be.

options: Do you happen to have anything that can restore memories quickly?
Do you know any tricks that could help me get my memories back as soon as possible?
Do you perhaps know some way of restoring my memory quickly after I make up my mind?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I do, but I can't recommend it. Let me think of how to put this...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Our lives are like an elastic belt. If you stretch out one side, the other side will contract.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: If you want to restore your memories 'quickly,' you will have to endure many unmanageable consequences.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That quaint head of yours might not withstand such a tussle. Besides, this only applies to the most common forms of 'amnesia.'

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Whether for your own sake, or for that of the little bunny who you value so much, I'd recommend just taking things easy.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: By the way, the little rabbit's up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Good morning.

options: Morning, Amiya.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I'll leave you two to it then. I'm going to fetch some firewood.
Amiya stands beside you quietly, watching the sun rising in the distance.
The rays of light are slowly melting the cold tones of the wastelands, every piece of the rocky desert dyed by the gradually rising sun.
Perhaps you have never set foot upon this land, but in a corner of Terra's vast domain, you once wandered with Amiya.
You once left your footprints in this sparsely populated world.
This should have been your impression, your fragments of your memory— but the truth is, this is the 'story' Kal'tsit told you.
In the cold wind of the early morning, you rack your brain, trying to find a tangible thread within your hazy memory.
The light of daybreak, the cold wind of the wastelands. You and Amiya, Amiya and you. You can remember, and yet you cannot remember.
Amiya takes hold of your hand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, are you okay?

options: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I remember it was around the same time. We spent our first night in the wastelands, and watched the sun rise over the horizon just like this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You asked me a bunch of weird questions...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha... Of course, all of that happened years ago, but it seems like it was just yesterday.

options: Sorry, Amiya... I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's okay, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As long as you're here, one day, things will get better.
The next day
2:39 P.M. \ Clear
Messenger Outpost
Several huge engineering vehicles and armed off-road transports make a circular formation on the rocky, barren expanses, surrounding several makeshift sheds.
The noisy din of generators and the roar of running Originium boilers can be heard near and far, intermingled with the loud conversations of travelers and Messengers.
The Messenger Outpost, an oasis of civilization beyond the ecological oasis of the wastelands, your destination.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Finally! We've arrived safely at the post!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: We didn't encounter any major difficulties on our journey, nor did a Catastrophe befall us. You are quite lucky indeed, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The third car from the left is the Messenger contact station here. You might be able to contact your group there. The Messenger rates here are pretty good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... the room over there has the logo of Mama John's on it. Are you sure it's fine?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: As long as you keep a low profile and don't cause any trouble, there won't be any problems. This is a Messenger outpost after all. Even in Columbia, few companies will go out of their way to get on the Messengers' bad side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Wait here for me. I don't stand out as much as you do, so I'll head down to the Messenger contact station.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Cannot, can I trouble you to stay with the Doctor for a while? I'll be right back.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Don't worry, little rabbit. I am good at hiding people from prying eyes. There won't be any problems.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Relax, friend. Look at those armed vehicles over there. Do you see those anti-armor turrets? Trust me, it's very safe here.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Here, have a sip.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It's a specialty from a local microbrewery. Give it a try.

options: Is this... beer?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Indeed. I've heard the owner of this microbrewery is an Infected. Unexpected, yes? Even among Columbia's pioneers, there are few who can accomplish this much.

options: Now is not the time to drink and make merry.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Fair enough. Why don't we go relax over there and listen to the news?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You know, the very best thing about Columbia is that they provide radio base stations for all the wasteland outposts. You can hear the news on the radio from just about anywhere.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Almost all cities have intra-city broadcasting, but the decision to cover the wilderness with base stations is unique in Terra. You should take it all in, and treat it like sightseeing.

steps.name: News Broadcast
steps.text: ...The armed conflict that occurred in the Northern District of Tkaronto has gradually subsided. On site, police found evidence of a large-scale crossbow shoot-out, but have not apprehended any suspects...

steps.name: News Broadcast
steps.text: ...The Tkaronto Police announced that one of the parties involved in the conflict has ties to a foreign company, 'Rhodes Island.' The specifics of this organization are not known at this time...

steps.name: News Broadcast
steps.text: ...Some sources note that this foreign company has certain commercial conflicts with a local firm, but the spokesperson of this local business declined to comment on the matter.

steps.name: News Broadcast
steps.text: The police believe that this may have been a terrorist attack on Tkaronto, and the specifics of this armed conflict are pending further investigation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You're back, little rabbit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The people at the Messenger contact station didn't come to work until three past noon, so we'll have to wait.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The news just now...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It sounds like your people have withdrawn successfully, which is a good thing.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But Mama John's probably got what it came for. Most regrettable.

options: We're the victims, but the police are looking for us.
The corporate intrigue here reminds me of Kazimierz.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hah, something like this is a routine operation in Columbia. That bunch moved quickly and wiped their asses in advance.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Don't dwell on it, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You'll leave this place soon enough. It's too late to manage this problem now, but be more mindful about it next time.

options: But what do they get out of a batch of semi-finished medicine samples?
Before that, Mr. Know-It-All, can you tell me why they're so desperate?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Very well... It seems that you've made up your mind.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Are you familiar with Columbia's business, my friend? How many times have you had to deal with them in the past?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island has had some simple dealings with a few Columbian technology companies.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Oh, I'm sure 'simple dealings' are decently good on the surface.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But, my friend, the ugly and indecent parts are not often placed on the table for everyone to see.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Come then. I will take you someplace, so you can see something fun.

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: Next!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: H-Hello... I need this month's dose.

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: Sure, let's take a look...

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: Mr. Dave, is it? Ah yes, I saw your application. You've been a model employee this past month. Here's your monthly medicine ration.

steps.name: Infected Dave
steps.text: Thank you... Thank you...

steps.name: Infected Dave
steps.text: Um, would it be possible... to get next month's dose in advance? My wife is in pretty bad shape lately, and I need...

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: Mr. Dave, according to company regulations, we are unable to provide any medication in advance. Thank you for your understanding.

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: But as you know, we always prepare additional medicine for commercial sale, and you can always go next door to purchase more Oripathy suppressants.

steps.name: Infected Dave
steps.text: B-But...

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: Company regulations, Mr. Dave. Thank you for your understanding.

steps.name: Corporate Staff
steps.text: Next!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What... what is this place?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Shhhh, hush. This is the Frontier Department of Mama John's. Keep a low profile.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're passing out medicine to the Infected?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: In Columbia, many things operate in a way unlike elsewhere in Terra.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: For example, consider the wasteland pioneers— Pioneers, the lifeblood of Columbia's westward expansion, the writers of Columbia's wilderness stories, the protagonists of the Columbian dream.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: They sign a contract with Mama John's and open up land in the barren wastes, establishing residential areas for Columbia and its companies.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Depending on how they work, companies will also provide them with medicine and supplies, as a sort of wage.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Here, take this.

options: The solid and liquid components are packaged separately. This is the medicine they distribute?
What... What on earth...?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: This is the medication that they give to the Infected. You are the expert here, I doubt you need me to explain.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is not an Oripathy suppressant.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course not, you know better than me. This half is a generic painkiller and the other half is a nutrient solution.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It's not a question of why, don't you see? They don't need to sell real suppressants.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: These pioneers, Infected from all over the world, have never seen a real Oripathy suppressant.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Though these things can't actually suppress Oripathy itself, they can relieve the symptoms of the disease. The product of Mama John's works, and works quickly, and that's good enough for them.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The concept of 'suppressant' is new to Terra, and naturally they wouldn't know.

options: Since they can make painkillers, they don't need to make real suppressants...
Why do they care about our technology then?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hahahaha... That story would be even more interesting.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Did you know, before Mama John's became a big name, they were just a donut chain. How could they have mastered the technology to produce drugs?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: All their pharmaceutical production lines are purchased from other companies such as Beachbrella, Tower Mountains, Rhine Lab...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Now that they sell painkillers as suppressants and make so much money, do you think the other pharmaceutical companies will sit on their hands?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: They've been thoroughly beaten down by other companies, but they've also learned a whole lot. This time, they've decided to directly off their partner, something that is distinctively Columbian.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: With your batch of samples in hand, I suspect the landscape of their cheap drugs will soon change.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: A more efficacious drug with a stronger analgesic will convince more people that this in fact is an 'Oripathy suppressant.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How can that be allowed?! Rhodes Island's samples are not Oripathy suppressants at all. Those samples haven't been tested for safety yet and might have serious side effects. We haven't...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Let me tell you what will happen next.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Mama John's will use your technology to make more and more 'suppressants' at lower costs.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, those poor pioneers will become the guinea pigs.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Will they die? Let me tell you the truth. Even without Mama John's, they will still die—

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: —Columbia's frontiers have been bought with the blood of the pioneers. Their life expectancy is not long regardless.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But those who remain, those whose lives were not claimed while paving the wilderness, are ever more likely to work for them in exchange for these so-called suppressants.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: This medicine gives some short-term pain relief. Maybe it can even buy them a few extra years.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Then, the newspapers across Columbia's major cities will publish headline after headline of their great achievements, right on the front page.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: 'Mama John's Strides Into Pharmaceuticals, Bringing New Hope to the Infected!'

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Impeccable!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: As for the truth, it is not at all important compared to the actual effectiveness of the analgesics.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course you can tell these poor people, 'those drugs that you're taking can't actually cure Oripathy, but can best be regarded as expensive painkillers and placebos.' And then what?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You keep telling the truth, saying that even the best suppressants by far can't bring back their completely normal lives and that they will continue to be accompanied by sickness and pain until they die.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: On the subject of Oripathy, Rhodes Island indeed stands at the bleeding edge in this world, so you know the truth. But is it a truth that they can stomach?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: And this... is Columbia, my friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Nothing will change, and everything makes sense. People come to Columbia with hope, create value with hope, and die with hope.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we can't just sit around and watch them use Rhodes Island to...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: See, this is very practical.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You cannot save them, nobody can save them. Not to mention, it is difficult even to protect yourselves now.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: For the Infected who harbor hope in their hearts, hope never existed in the first place, and you know this better than they do.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You should contact your people sooner rather than later, and find a way to get back.

options: You're right, Mr. Cannot.
I don't want to admit it, but facts are facts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I know, that hope is a cruel thing indeed.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: When you realize it can't be undone, when you realize you are powerless, when you find yourself nothing but desperate...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hope is enough to drive a perfectly good person mad.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: People believe what they want to believe, and that makes them feel much better.
You look over at Amiya. You watch her ears slowly droop, her eyes filled with sadness, then stained with helplessness.
The two of you have seen much, but you both will see more still. You both understand all this, and in fact, there is no need for the wasteland merchant to explain it again.
In the distance, along the border between the wastelands and the sky, the sun slowly sinks.
Day is about to draw to an end in Terra's wastelands. The light is about to fade, and the twin moons will soon take its place in the sky.
The sun will still rise tomorrow, but not every Infected will see the coming dawn.
Even if there are enough drugs to suppress Oripathy in this place, it is too late for so many more. Nothing will change.
Nothing will change?

options: But— Mr. Cannot.
Even if hope will continue to bring us pain, I still think it's worth it.
If we give up on hope, what is the meaning of everything we've had to endure?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Oh! Quite the rousing speech, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You did not convince me, for you will find it hard to do so, but I felt the sincerity of your emotions.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I do like how you still refuse to bow to reality despite having seen it, though to be honest, you've already embarrassed yourselves.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Let's put that speech aside for now. I know that you two are very practical people, so I will also pose a very practical question. I'm quite curious, what will you do next?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You've already arrived at the Messenger Outpost at the border, and you will be leaving this place soon.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Do you plan to turn around and head back? What then?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: To be frank, my friend, unless you have some way of getting your things back from them, you will have a very hard time resolving these matters.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Will you charge there single-handedly with all guns blazing? Should I lend you a burdenbeast so you can look like a hero of the vale from the indigenous Columbian peoples' folklore?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Oh, I almost forgot, you can't fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Cannot, please don't say that about the Doctor.

options: No, Amiya, he's right.
Sometimes, we don't necessarily need to use force.
We can use their own ways to resolve the problem— and I just happen to have some practice.
In order to get Rhodes Island out of here safely, we have to get crafty.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: From the sound of things, you plan to appeal to reason?
Four days later
4:01 P.M. \ Clear
Columbia Detention Center

steps.name: Columbian Police
steps.text: Alright, you can leave now.

options: Thank you. Thank you very much.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

options: It went well, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't do that again! I was really... I was worried sick!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You played your bag of tricks quite well, my friend. Very clever.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I'm glad that the little excursion I took you on was not in vain, nor was me waiting out here for a few days. I really did underestimate you.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But, I am a bit scared of you now, my friend.

options: I'll take that as a compliment.
...It's alright.
To be honest, I was a bit scared too when I woke up to a bucket-head.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I still don't understand... what happened.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Simply stated... our clever friend here voluntarily surrendered to Columbian Customs and Border Protection, saying that your company had smuggled a batch of Oripathy-related drugs into Columbia.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: If you know anything about Columbian laws, you should know that Oripathy-related drugs are the most strictly-regulated medical products.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The company that lobbied to implement this law in the past spent a lot of efforts to monopolize the drug market in Columbia.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The information provided by our friend here definitely alarmed the Columbian Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium, and they certainly aren't easy to deal with.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Per protocol, the Bureau's security forces went there in no time and seized all items in this smuggled product trade.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, we have complete contracts and records of our cooperation with them, which should be easy to find...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hahaha, that's the important part.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Miss Rabbit, when they chose to attack you, they had no intention of leaving any footprints. They have destroyed all evidence of this cooperation, and nothing would match up in the investigation.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: So what kind of situation will prevent a company from leaving behind any evidence of a transaction?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: What else but shady business.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So it was the Columbian government that seizes all the samples...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: According to law, they will destroy these smuggled goods, and then? There's nothing after that. Mama John's is pretty much omnipotent around here, but what if the scope extends to cover all of Columbia?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Columbian Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium. Their name might be a mouthful, but they have some competent people. And they'll be watching closely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand now... But even with that being the case, won't Rhodes Island have a blackened record?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hahaha, this is Columbia after all. There's not a company out there with a perfectly wiped rear.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Pay a fine, sign off on the ticket, and it won't be long until people forget about it— perhaps, people might have stopped caring already.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: After all, in order to cover their ass, Mama John's might have inadvertently given Rhodes Island its best cover— and in case the Bureau really came for Rhodes Island, they would be the ones in trouble.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, your Doctor did spend three days in the Bureau's detention room, which is its own price.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's hard for me to evaluate this move, Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit is going to be mad.

options: That she will be, but if there's anything I know about her...
I'll just tell her I learned it from watching her.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I wouldn't mouth off like that if I were you...

options: Oh, Blaze. The gang's all here.

steps.text: The well-built Feline operator is looking at you with eyes of helplessness.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doctor, you caused a real big uproar this time around...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Fines, fees, jail time, and even the Columbian government investigating illegitimate business practices...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But I have no clue how you managed to sort it all out. I almost had to call Dr. Kal'tsit myself.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How the hell are you gonna explain all this to her when you get back?

options: I... have my ways.
Uhh, beg for mercy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Please don't ever take a gamble like this in the future. We could contact the ship and wait for support!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides, Rhodes Island actually has a contingency plan for dealing with situations like this.

options: At least the trip through the wastelands was fun, wasn't it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Fun? ...I suppose, just a little...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Don't change the subject!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After we get back, you have to tell the whole truth to Dr. Kal'tsit. I'll help you with the report.

options: Okay...
Thanks...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Then I suppose it is time to part ways, my friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: As I said before, our journey together was most enjoyable.

options: Yes, it definitely was. Thank you so much, Mr. Cannot.
Thanks for everything. We may meet again someday.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I do believe we will meet again in the near future.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Until then, I wish you good health. See you later.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Who was that? Gave me the sense there was something else under that nice front of his...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor?

options: Hmm?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's something I'd like to ask you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Back then, you said you needed Mr. Cannot to do a little favor for you. What was it?
Three days ago
3:27 P.M. \ Clear
Somewhere in the wastelands

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You're a real crazy one, friend.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: That's a rather destructive trick you've got there.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: So, what do you need my help with?

options: Though we don't want to use force, I still want to keep the option open.
I would like your people to protect Amiya, up until she leaves safely.
Maybe your people can ensure that Rhodes Island doesn't come under attack.
In case of emergency, I'd like your people to do some clean-up work for me.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Oi! Hold up, easy now.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: What do you mean by 'my people?'

options: Mr. Cannot, I hope you can at least be honest with me now.
We've been followed the whole way, right?
We might just be lucky, as you said. But is it really just luck?

steps.text: The strange man has gone silent, but you can't judge his expression under the thick bucket helm. However, you feel that the silence harbors neither anger nor dissatisfaction.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Well done, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I thought my friends did a good job concealing themselves. This whole time, I took you for an intelligent but overly sentimental person.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You truly are full of surprises.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Well then, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course I can help you with this little favor, though I believe that with Miss Amiya's skills, she won't really need my help.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But business is business, and what can you offer me?

options: I'll turn a blind eye to the documents you took from our car.
How does that sound to you?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Beautifully played, friend. It's a deal.

options: If everything goes well, we will see you in three days.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, my friend. I wish you the best of luck.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: All right, you can come out now.

steps.name: Fiends Gang Member
steps.text: You alone? Is it over?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Not quite. The upcoming show should be quite entertaining.

steps.name: Fiends Gang Member
steps.text: That one's extremely dangerous. We shouldn't let 'em go.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: We could come up against that Rhodes Island. Why should we help them?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Just trust me. The existence of an organization like theirs is good for us.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The longer such people live, the more interesting this world will become.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Let's go, friends. We still have a lot of work to do.
